news.title: Esha Media Research Limited to Report Fiscal Year 2026 Results on May 14, 2026
news.body: Esha Media Research Limited announced that they will report fiscal year 2026 results at 12:15 PM, Indian Standard Time on May 14, 2026

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Additional Independent Director Dimple Joshi is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2026. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.74 loss per share (vs ₹0.23 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.74 loss per share (down from ₹0.23 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹5.09m (down 58% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹5.81m (down 429% from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 155 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Esha Media Research Ltd. Announces Board Changes, Effective February 13, 2026
news.body: Esha Media Research Ltd. held a meeting of the Board of Directors on February 13, 2026. The Board of Directors took note of resignation of Mr. Shishir Dileep Joshi as an Independent Director of the Company with effect from February 13, 2026. The Board of Directors approved appointment of Ms. Dimple Joshi (DIN: 10418431) as an Additional Independent Director of the Company based on the recommendation of Nomination and Remuneration Committee with effect from February 13, 2026. The Board of Directors reviewed and discussed Internal Audit Report for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 along with the Management Response and observations of the Audit Committee.

news.title: Esha Media Research Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 13, 2026
news.body: Esha Media Research Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 13, 2026

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.43 loss per share (vs ₹4.78 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.43 loss per share (improved from ₹4.78 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹7.01m (up 83% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹3.35m (loss narrowed 91% from 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 189 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
